effects.effect: Each time you use your [My Life for Yours](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.censor.level-1/my-life-for-yours) ability, you gain 1 wrath that can be spent only on that ability during the same [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn). If you don't use this wrath, it is lost. Additionally, the target of [My Life for Yours](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.censor.level-1/my-life-for-yours) gains 10 [temporary Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/temporary-stamina).
